Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol VI - Potted Flowers (Small)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=6][u][center][b]Artdew Valley Vol VI[/b][/center]
[/u][/size][/color]
[i][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b]Because nothing adds more color to a home than beautiful immortal flowers that are harder than childhood in Af... Oh no, no, no.[/b][/size][/color][/i]



[/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the sixth of them. This volume focuses on adding 30 potted plants that contain different and beautiful pixel art-style forms. [/i][color=#ffff00](This volume alone adds 30 potted flowers, making a total of 60 if you count all 2 volumes focused on potted flowers.)[/color][/b][/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can get all these plants at [color=#00ff00]Pierre's shop[/color] for a modest price of 600g each.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You will find 6 potted plants available per day, on [color=#00ff00]Mondays, Tuesday, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays[/color]. During that time, you will be able to obtain all 30 potted plants available in this volume.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All the plants in this volume are small and take up little space, so they can be placed on surfaces.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]


[/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][i][b]That's it, I couldn't wait to get this over with, but here we are!!!!!! I hope you enjoy the mod.[/b][/i][/size][/color]



[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
